create_orbit_camera: create an OrbitCamera instance with width, height, radius, and fovy parameters for 3D scene viewing
get_camera_pose: get the 4x4 camera pose matrix from an OrbitCamera using its pose property
get_camera_intrinsics: get the camera intrinsics array including focal length and principal point from OrbitCamera
orbit_camera_view: orbit the OrbitCamera view by calling orbit with dx and dy delta values
create_nerf_gui: create a NeRFGUI interactive viewer with a NeRF system, width, height, radius, and fovy
